SELECT id, x FROM (SELECT id, g COLLATE NOCASE AS g, k, p, v FROM (VALUES (1, 'b', 1, 1, 4.0), (2, 'B', 1, 1, 5.0),
        (3, 'b', 1, 2, 6.0), (4, 'a', 1, 1, 7.0)) r(id, g, k, p, v)) t DECIDE x(REAL) SUCH THAT x <= 9 AND x <= at(previous else 0: t.v) over (t.p within t.g) MAXIMIZE sum(x)
